title: Abnormals Bushy Leaves Modded Compats
description: Compatibility for Hatsondogs' Abnormals Bushy Leaves Texture Pack for other Mods!
body:
This resource pack adds compatibility for Hatsondogs' [Abnormals Bushy Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/abnormals-bushy-leaves), so your forests can look bushier and leafier!

Supported Mods:

Spawn (Date)

No Man's Land (Autumnal Oak, Yellow Birch, Frosted, Pine, Walnut, Willow, Pale Cherry) 

Cultural Delights (Avocado)

![All the leaves added in the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc496891569e0eef00c089b1eb4d67456bf8e452.png)

More compatibility may be added in the future!
